raw_text:
PLAN "Couch-to-5K for 24yo male with exercise-induced asthma"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "Complete 5K in 12 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk & Easy Run Intro":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 6x1..1 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Easy Continuous Walk + Strides":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          brisk_walk 20m rpe 5
          strides 6x20..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Long Walk with Easy Jog Segments":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 4x2..1 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Progressive Walk/Jog":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 5x2..1 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Easy Run Focus":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 15m rpe 6
          strides 6x20..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Long Walk with Jog":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          walk_run_intervals 3x3..2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Continuous Jog Intro":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 12m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Intervals - Build Time Running":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          jog_intervals 4x4..2 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Long Walk/Jog":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 20m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Sustained Easy Jog":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 18m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Strides & Form":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 12m rpe 6
          strides 8x20..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Long Easy Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 25m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m

  PHASE "Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Continuous Run Increase":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 25m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Tempo Intro":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_pace 10m rpe 7
          easy_jog 10m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Long Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 30m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Interval Endurance":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 5x3..2 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Tempo Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_pace 12m rpe 7
          easy_jog 8m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Long Run Increase":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 35m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Sustained Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 30m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Intervals for Pace":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 6x2..2 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Long Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 40m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Tempo + Jog":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_pace 15m rpe 7
          easy_jog 10m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Strides & Form":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 18m rpe 6
          strides 8x30..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Long Run Comfortable":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 45m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m

  PHASE "Sharpen & Race Prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Race Pace Practice":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          race_pace_run 12m rpe 7
          easy_jog 15m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Intervals - Race Specific":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 6x3..2 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Long Run with Pickups":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 50m rpe 6
          pickups 6x20..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Sustained Race Pace":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          race_pace_run 18m rpe 7
          easy_jog 10m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Short Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 8x1..1 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Taper Long Run":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 35m rpe 6
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Easy Run & Strides":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 20m rpe 6
          strides 6x20..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Sharp Short Session":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          run_intervals 5x1..1 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Easy Shakeout":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 15m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Pre-Race Easy":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 15m rpe 5
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Pre-Race Strides":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          easy_jog 10m rpe 5
          strides 4x20..30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 5m
      DAY Saturday training 40m "Race Day 5K":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          race_5k_run 1x1 rpe 8
        cooldown:
          easy_walk 10m
